subject: GATE Data Science and Artificial Intelligence

topics: Verbal Aptitude: grammar, vocabulary, reading comprehension, analogies
Quantitative Aptitude: arithmetic, percentages, ratios, data interpretation, mensuration
Analytical Aptitude: logic, deduction, relationships, seating arrangements, counting
Spatial Aptitude: shapes, rotation, mirror images, paper folding, patterns
Counting, axioms of probability, conditional probability, Bayes theorem, independence
Discrete and continuous random variables: Bernoulli, binomial, Poisson, uniform, exponential, normal
Mean, variance, covariance, correlation, conditional expectation
Central limit theorem and sampling distributions
Confidence intervals and hypothesis testing: z-test, t-test, chi-squared test
Vector spaces, subspaces, linear dependence and independence
Matrices, rank, determinant, inverse, projection, orthogonal and idempotent matrices
Systems of linear equations and Gaussian elimination
Eigenvalues, eigenvectors, determinant and trace
Matrix decompositions: LU, singular value decomposition, quadratic forms
Functions of a single variable: limits, continuity, differentiability
Taylor series
Maxima and minima
Optimization involving a single variable
Programming in Python
Stacks, queues, linked lists, trees and hash tables
Search algorithms: linear and binary search
Sorting algorithms: selection, bubble, insertion, merge sort, quicksort
Divide and conquer
Graph theory: traversals and shortest path
ER model, relational model, relational algebra, tuple calculus, SQL
Integrity constraints and normal forms
File organization and indexing
Data types, data transformation: normalization, discretization, sampling, compression
Data warehouse modelling: schema, concept hierarchies, measures
Regression: simple and multiple linear regression, ridge regression
Classification: logistic regression, k-nearest neighbour, naive Bayes, linear discriminant analysis, support vector machine, decision trees
Bias-variance trade-off, cross-validation methods
Neural networks: multi-layer perceptron, feed-forward networks
Unsupervised learning: k-means, k-medoid, hierarchical clustering
Dimensionality reduction: principal component analysis
Search: informed, uninformed and adversarial search
Logic: propositional and predicate logic
Reasoning under uncertainty: conditional independence, exact and approximate inference, Bayesian networks
